response: Saved Views is available today, giving you a faster way to organize how you and your team work. Instead of rebuilding filters and sort orders every time you open a project, you can now save any combination of filters, grouping, and sorting as a named view that's ready whenever you need it. Saved Views is included in all paid plans, so every team on a paid subscription can start using it right away. Each user can save up to 50 views, covering everything from daily task lists to quarterly reporting dashboards. When a view is useful beyond your own workflow, you can share it with your team, so everyone sees the same filtered, sorted list without recreating it themselves. This makes it easier to standardize how your team tracks priorities, deadlines, and progress across projects. We think this small addition will save real time across your daily workflow. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
